panel.title: What stays writable
panel.description: Ending a trial or moving to a smaller plan deletes nothing. When the organization has more than the {plan} plan allows, what is past a limit becomes read-only: Owners keep their seats, then what you choose here stays writable, then the oldest. Archiving a project, ending a membership or upgrading makes things writable again at once.

panel.room: Keep up to {room, plural, one {# writable} other {# writable}}. Without a choice, the oldest stay writable.
